records.context: Every vertex is a world coordinate taken from :meth:`spacr.layers.Canvas.world_at`, and the polygon being drawn is a real :class:`~spacr.layers.Shape` in a real :class:`~spacr.layers.ShapesLayer`. So the half-finished ROI is rendered by the same compositor as everything else, it survives a zoom, and the finished ROI is already in the form :meth:`spacr.roi.RoiSet.from_shapes_layer` reads. Nothing about the drawing is in pixels, which is what lets an ROI drawn on a downsampled preview name the same region on a full-resolution mask.
records.label: spacr.qt.roi_tool#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Every vertex is a world coordinate taken from :meth:`spacr.layers.Canvas.world_at`, and the polygon being drawn is a real :class:`~spacr.layers.Shape` in a real :class:`~spacr.layers.ShapesLayer`. So the half-finished ROI is rendered by the same compositor as everything else, it survives a zoom, and the finished ROI is already in the form :meth:`spacr.roi.RoiSet.from_shapes_layer` reads. Nothing about the drawing is in pixels, which is what lets an ROI drawn on a downsampled preview name the same region on a full-resolution mask.
records.translation: हर vertex :meth:`spacr.layers.Canvas.world_at` से लिया गया world निर्देशांक है, और बनाया जा रहा polygon एक वास्तविक :class:`~spacr.layers.Shape` है, जो वास्तविक :class:`~spacr.layers.ShapesLayer` में रहता है। इसलिए आधा बना ROI बाकी सब की तरह उसी compositor से रेंडर होता है, zoom के बाद भी बना रहता है, और पूरा ROI पहले से उस रूप में है जिसे :meth:`spacr.roi.RoiSet.from_shapes_layer` पढ़ता है। drawing का कुछ भी पिक्सेल में नहीं है, और इसी से downsampled preview पर बना ROI पूर्ण-रिज़ॉल्यूशन mask पर उसी क्षेत्र को दर्शाता है।

records.context: The disclosure level is changed only when necessary, and the change is not remembered. Switching to All settings unconditionally would work, and it would also rewrite this module's remembered Essentials/All choice every time anybody arrived here -- a setting the user chose, changed as a side effect of looking something up. So the filter is cleared first and the level is raised only when the row is still not on the form afterwards, which is exactly the case where Essentials is what is hiding it; and the raise goes through :meth:`_show_all_without_remembering`, so the form shows the row while the store still holds the level the user picked. Most settings are not essentials, so a lookup that persisted the raise would move almost every module out of Essentials for good.

records.context: :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.registry` -- the process-wide ``RunRegistry`` that ``make_thread`` adds every job to. Not an ad-hoc "busy" flag each caller has to remember to set and, more importantly, remember to clear: the registry is the same state every application view's ``active_jobs()`` is counting, and it is maintained by ``make_thread`` itself, so a job that forgets to tell anyone it started still turns the spinner on.

records.context: So the widget waits :func:`spacr.qt.preferences.get_spinner_delay` seconds (default 2) before showing. The mechanism is a **delay, not a prediction**: :meth:`ActivitySpinner._sync` starts a single-shot timer the moment work begins and the spinner becomes visible only if :meth:`ActivitySpinner.is_busy` is *still* true when that timer fires. A job that finishes at 1.9 s cancels the timer on its way out and never puts anything on application view -- no duration is estimated.

records.translation: इसलिए widget दिखने से पहले :func:`spacr.qt.preferences.get_spinner_delay` सेकंड (डिफ़ॉल्ट 2) प्रतीक्षा करता है। तंत्र **delay, not a prediction** है: काम शुरू होते ही :meth:`ActivitySpinner._sync` एक single-shot timer शुरू करता है और spinner केवल तब दिखता है जब वह timer चलने पर :meth:`ActivitySpinner.is_busy` *still* true हो। 1.9 s पर समाप्त होने वाला job जाते-जाते timer रद्द कर देता है और स्क्रीन पर कभी कुछ नहीं रखता -- कोई अवधि अनुमानित नहीं की जाती।

records.context: The clock executes on the *work*, not on the job. A second job starting while the timer is pending does not restart it: the timer is armed on the idle-to-busy edge only, so two seconds of continuous background activity shows the spinner even if no single job lasted that long. Going idle disarms it, and the next burst of work starts a fresh two seconds.

records.context: **Size.** 800x600, 144 frames, 682 KB on disk. ``QMovie`` decodes a frame to a 32-bit ``QImage``, so one frame is 800 x 600 x 4 = 1.92 MB and the whole loop is 276 MB. ``QMovie.CacheAll`` holds all of it; ``CacheNone`` (the default) trades that for re-decoding 1.92 MB, and rescaling it to 16 px, 33 times a second, forever.

records.translation: **Size.** 800x600, 144 frames, disk पर 682 KB। ``QMovie`` एक frame को 32-bit ``QImage`` में डिकोड करता है, इसलिए एक frame 800 x 600 x 4 = 1.92 MB है और पूरा loop 276 MB। ``QMovie.CacheAll`` यह सब रखता है; ``CacheNone`` (डिफ़ॉल्ट) इसके बदले हमेशा, सेकंड में 33 बार, 1.92 MB दोबारा डिकोड करता और उसे 16 px तक rescale करता है।

records.context: Pre-scaling the frames once into ``QPixmap`` objects fixes the per-frame cost but none of the other two, and it still costs a 276 MB decode pass at start-up for a 16 px dot. So the motif is redrawn instead: the GIF's *character* is a thin ring with a double-helix braid travelling around it (see the frames -- the braid sweeps, the ring stays), and that is exactly what :meth:`ActivitySpinner.paintEvent` draws with two ``QPolygonF`` objects. It costs microseconds, it takes its colours from the live palette so it themes in both light and dark, and it is sharp at any size.

records.translation: frames को एक बार ``QPixmap`` ऑब्जेक्टों में पहले से स्केल करना प्रति-frame लागत ठीक करता है लेकिन बाकी दो में से कोई नहीं, और फिर भी 16 px के बिंदु के लिए start-up पर 276 MB का डिकोड पास लगता है। इसलिए motif फिर से बनाया जाता है: GIF का *character* एक पतली अंगूठी है जिसके चारों ओर double-helix braid घूमती है (frames देखें -- braid घूमती है, अंगूठी स्थिर रहती है), और ठीक यही :meth:`ActivitySpinner.paintEvent` दो ``QPolygonF`` ऑब्जेक्टों से बनाता है। इसकी लागत microseconds है, यह अपने रंग live palette से लेता है इसलिए light और dark दोनों थीम में ढलता है, और किसी भी आकार पर स्पष्ट है।

records.context: There is one column model, read in one direction. A second table above the first, both told to keep the same widths, would be two column models kept in step (see the `_ClusterSettingsDialog` docstring on two editors of one setting). This layout owns no widths. It asks the paired table's ``QHeaderView`` where each section starts and how wide it is, every time it lays out, and it writes nothing back: the header never learns that a strip is following it, so there is nothing to drift.

records.translation: एक ही column मॉडल है, जो एक ही दिशा में पढ़ा जाता है। पहली के ऊपर दूसरी तालिका, दोनों को समान चौड़ाई रखने को कहा जाए, तो दो column मॉडल होते जिन्हें तालमेल में रखना पड़ता (एक सेटिंग के दो editors पर `_ClusterSettingsDialog` docstring देखें)। यह layout कोई चौड़ाई नहीं रखता। यह हर बार layout करते समय paired तालिका के ``QHeaderView`` से पूछता है कि हर section कहाँ शुरू होता है और कितना चौड़ा है, और वापस कुछ नहीं लिखता: header को कभी पता नहीं चलता कि कोई पट्टी उसका पालन कर रही है, इसलिए अलग होने को कुछ नहीं है।

records.context: A QLayout is used rather than spacers in a QHBoxLayout. records.context: The reads leave the main GUI execution path deliberately: the summary stats every database and then opens each with sqlite, over paths that are the user's own -- one of them an autofs mount that had not answered a single stat after twenty seconds -- and doing that while a settings panel lays out froze the application. Returning ``['/data/plate1']`` where a string was returned before would change what every one of those sees for a user who chose one folder -- exactly the regression the one-element list caused for ``column_csv`` (see ``settings_model.PATH_LIST_SINGLE_KEYS``).
records.translation: हमेशा सूची नहीं। spaCR में मॉड्यूल होने के समय से ``src`` हर मॉड्यूल के लिए string रहा है, और यह settings CSV में लिखा जाता है, CLI द्वारा पढ़ा जाता है, run journal द्वारा दोहराया जाता है और ``os.path.join(src, ...)`` करने वाली किसी भी चीज़ से जोड़ा जाता है। जहाँ पहले string लौटता था वहाँ ``['/data/plate1']`` लौटाना एक folder चुनने वाले उपयोगकर्ता के लिए इन सबका देखा हुआ बदल देता -- ठीक वही regression जो एक-तत्व सूची ने ``column_csv`` के लिए किया था (``settings_model.PATH_LIST_SINGLE_KEYS`` देखें)।

records.context: **Dwell, not touch.** Entering the strip starts :data:`EdgeDrawer.OPEN_DELAY_MS`; a pointer that crosses the strip on its way somewhere else has left again before the timer fires.

records.context: The context-menu route is deliberately an application-level event filter rather than an edit to each table application view. There are eleven table-bearing application views and none of them claims a context menu today, so a filter reaches all of them — including the ones built lazily, long after this hook ran — and reaches any table added later for free. It stands aside for any widget that has claimed its own context menu (``CustomContextMenu`` / ``ActionsContextMenu``), so adopting one later silently takes precedence over this.

records.context: The event type is read first, and the liveness checks follow it. This filter is on the QApplication, so both `_still_alive` calls used to execute for every event in the process -- 94,431 of them during one Regression open, and a profile counted the pair at 839,906 calls in one Mask open. records.source: The event type is read first, and the liveness checks follow it. This filter is on the QApplication, so both `_still_alive` calls used to run for every event in the process -- 94,431 of them during one Regression open, and a profile counted the pair at 839,906 calls in one Mask open. Reading the type of an object whose C++ half has gone raises, which the `except` below already answers with the same `False`, so the order costs nothing and the checks now run only for a context menu.
records.translation: पहले event प्रकार पढ़ा जाता है, और जीवितता की जाँचें उसके बाद होती हैं। यह filter QApplication पर है, इसलिए दोनों `_still_alive` कॉल पहले प्रक्रिया के हर event पर चलती थीं -- एक Regression खोलने में 94,431 events, और एक profile ने एक Mask खोलने में इस जोड़ी को 839,906 कॉल गिना। जिस ऑब्जेक्ट का C++ भाग नष्ट हो चुका है उसका प्रकार पढ़ने पर त्रुटि होती है, जिसका उत्तर नीचे का `except` पहले से उसी `False` से देता है, इसलिए इस क्रम की कोई लागत नहीं और जाँचें अब केवल context menu के लिए चलती हैं।

records.context: Only one tooltip ever appears. The application views that anchor this popup also leave a native Qt tooltip on the same label (``refresh_api_tooltips`` re-applies it on every ``Enter``, for the accessibility tree), and Qt's own tooltip timer would pop that up a second later, on top of this one — two tooltips, one after the other. Claiming an anchor therefore installs :class:`_NativeTooltipSuppressor` on it, which swallows ``QEvent.ToolTip`` while leaving ``toolTip()`` intact for application view readers.

records.context: The walk over dropped paths executes on its own worker. A drop is a path the user chose, and a laboratory microplate lives on the microscope's share: one ``os.path.exists`` under a sleeping autofs mount had not returned after twenty seconds, and a walk is thousands of those. Run inline, the walk would freeze the application without a traceback, because a stalled event loop is not a crash. The runner is marked not user-visible because dropping a folder is not starting a processing session, and it is safe to do so because that runner carries nothing but the walk.

records.source: The walk over dropped paths runs on its own worker. A drop is a path the user chose, and a plate lives on the microscope's share: one ``os.path.exists`` under a sleeping autofs mount had not returned after twenty seconds, and a walk is thousands of those. Run inline, the walk would freeze the application without a traceback, because a stalled event loop is not a crash. The runner is marked not user-visible because dropping a folder is not starting a run, and it is safe to do so because that runner carries nothing but the walk.
records.translation: drop किए गए पथों पर चलना अपने worker पर होता है। drop उपयोगकर्ता का चुना पथ है, और plate microscope के share पर रहती है: सोए autofs mount के अंतर्गत एक ``os.path.exists`` बीस सेकंड बाद भी नहीं लौटा था, और एक walk ऐसे हज़ारों होते हैं। inline चलाने पर walk बिना traceback के एप्लिकेशन जाम कर देता, क्योंकि रुका event loop crash नहीं है। runner उपयोगकर्ता को न दिखने वाला चिह्नित है क्योंकि folder drop करना run शुरू करना नहीं है, और यह सुरक्षित है क्योंकि वह runner walk के अलावा कुछ नहीं रखता।

records.source: Compare measurements between selected cell groups and a reference. Build the comparison panel: the pickers, the plot and the statistics.
records.translation: चुने गए cell समूहों और एक reference के बीच माप की तुलना करता है। तुलना panel बनाता है: pickers, plot और statistics।

records.context: The panel opens with the top hits selected: the top significant guides or genes and the microplate sample positions that carry them, which the user can change. The regression's results table gives the hits (:func:`spacr.well_scope._top_hits`); without one, the guides of the montage's own groups are the selection. The population box then starts on "gRNAs + other datapoints in selected microplate sample positions", the derived microplate sample positions are shown under the controls, and "gRNAs…" / "selected wells…" change either. Nothing to select starts on "All datapoints", so a panel with no guides still draws what it drew before.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.measurement_compare_dialog.MeasurementComparePanel#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The panel opens with the top hits selected: the top significant guides or genes and the wells that carry them, which the user can change. The regression's results table gives the hits (:func:`spacr.well_scope._top_hits`); without one, the guides of the montage's own groups are the selection. The population box then starts on "gRNAs + other datapoints in selected wells", the derived wells are shown under the controls, and "gRNAs…" / "selected wells…" change either. Nothing to select starts on "All datapoints", so a panel with no guides still draws what it drew before.
records.translation: panel शीर्ष hits चुने हुए के साथ खुलता है: शीर्ष सार्थक guides या genes और उन्हें रखने वाले wells, जिन्हें उपयोगकर्ता बदल सकता है। regression की results तालिका hits देती है (:func:`spacr.well_scope._top_hits`); उसके बिना montage के अपने समूहों के guides ही चयन हैं। फिर population box "gRNAs + other datapoints in selected wells" पर शुरू होता है, निकाले गए wells नियंत्रणों के नीचे दिखाए जाते हैं, और "gRNAs…" / "selected wells…" किसी को भी बदलते हैं। चुनने को कुछ न होने पर यह "All datapoints" (सभी datapoints) पर शुरू होता है, इसलिए बिना guides वाला panel भी वही बनाता है जो पहले बनाता था।

records.context: The join runs off the main GUI execution path. It reads every object table out of every attached database and joins them onto the extracted image region rows -- measured at 3.2 s for one laboratory microplate's 553 objects, so a four-laboratory microplate application view of 60,000 would block the window for minutes.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.measurement_compare_dialog.MeasurementComparePanel#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The join runs off the GUI thread. It reads every object table out of every attached database and joins them onto the crop rows -- measured at 3.2 s for one plate's 553 objects, so a four-plate screen of 60,000 would block the window for minutes.
records.translation: join GUI thread से बाहर चलता है। यह हर जुड़े database से हर object तालिका पढ़ता है और उन्हें crop पंक्तियों से जोड़ता है -- एक plate के 553 ऑब्जेक्टों के लिए 3.2 s मापा गया, इसलिए 60,000 वाली चार-plate स्क्रीनिंग विंडो को मिनटों तक रोक देती।

records.context: Colour: every colour painted here is derived from the theme that is on application view, never written as a literal, and the derivation preserves the relative luminance of the theme's own accent role. records.context: The difference from :meth:`add_widget` IS `_row_widgets`, and it is the whole reason this exists. Every entry there is taken to BE a labelled setting row by ``tests/qt/test_all_module_smoke.py::_setting_row_contract``, which asserts each field carries a ``settingKey`` and that its label is a QLabel holding linked API help. records.context: The ray from the centre, not the nearest edge. Projecting a point onto whichever edge happens to be closest is discontinuous along the diagonals: the pointer crosses one and the target jumps from the middle of the top edge to the middle of the left, which is what was reported as the rim being unsynced with the pointer inside the card. The point where the ray from the centre through the pointer leaves the rectangle moves continuously, and is always the place on the rim that is actually in the pointer's direction -- which is what "flows towards the mouse" has to mean if the mouse can be anywhere.

The point where the ray from the centre through the pointer leaves the rectangle moves continuously, and is always the place on the rim that is actually in the pointer's direction -- which is what "flows towards the mouse" has to mean if the mouse can be anywhere.
records.translation: THE RAY FROM THE CENTRE, निकटतम किनारा नहीं। किसी बिंदु को जो भी किनारा सबसे निकट हो उस पर project करना विकर्णों के साथ असतत है: pointer एक को पार करता है और लक्ष्य ऊपरी किनारे के बीच से बाएँ किनारे के बीच कूद जाता है, और इसी को card के भीतर किनारे का pointer से असमन्वित होना बताया गया था। केंद्र से pointer की ओर जाने वाली किरण जिस बिंदु पर आयत छोड़ती है वह निरंतर चलता है, और हमेशा किनारे का वह स्थान है जो वास्तव में pointer की दिशा में है -- और यदि माउस कहीं भी हो सकता है तो "flows towards the mouse" (माउस की ओर बहता है) का यही अर्थ होना चाहिए।

records.translation: ``TrackStats`` बता सकता है कि 30-frame श्रृंखला में एक field ने 6 frames की median लंबाई वाले 41 tracks बनाए। यह *why* नहीं बता सकता, और कारण ही तय करता है कि कौन-सी सेटिंग बदलनी है: दो cells जो तीन frames तक छूते हैं और अपनी पहचान बदलकर अलग होते हैं, उन्हें उस एक cell से अलग सेटिंग चाहिए जो field छोड़कर वापस आता है।

records.context: Three design rules:
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.volcano_explorer#2

records.source: Three design rules:
records.translation: तीन design नियम:

records.context: **One renderer.** Every pixel comes from :func:`spacr.volcano_style.render_volcano`, the same function the headless workflow calls. Exporting re-renders from the same :class:`VolcanoStyle` at print size rather than screenshotting the widget, so what is saved is what was on application view, at full vector quality.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.volcano_explorer#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **One renderer.** Every pixel comes from :func:`spacr.volcano_style.render_volcano`, the same function the headless pipeline calls. Exporting re-renders from the same :class:`VolcanoStyle` at print size rather than screenshotting the widget, so what is saved is what was on screen, at full vector quality.
records.translation: **One renderer.** हर पिक्सेल :func:`spacr.volcano_style.render_volcano` से आता है, वही फ़ंक्शन जिसे headless pipeline कॉल करती है। export widget का screenshot लेने के बजाय उसी :class:`VolcanoStyle` से print आकार पर फिर से रेंडर करता है, इसलिए जो सहेजा जाता है वह वही है जो स्क्रीन पर था, पूर्ण vector गुणवत्ता में।

records.context: **The style is a value.** Controls write into a :class:`~spacr.volcano_style.VolcanoStyle` and ask for a redraw. That makes the whole appearance saveable to JSON, reloadable, and reproducible.
